functions.name: readGoogleStamps
functions.description: Walk every contact card in the given address book and read the legacy X-GOOGLE-RESOURCENAME / X-GOOGLE-ETAG properties off the underlying nsIAbCard's userProperty bag — the place legacy google-4-tbsync wrote them via setProperty(). Modern Thunderbird does not always surface these properties in the WebExtension-visible vCard, so we have to reach for them via XPCOM.

parameters.name: bookId
parameters.description: Address book UID (the same id the WebExtension addressBooks API exposes).
